description: This file defines a controller class 'RecruitmentModuleController' inside the namespace 'OrangeHRM\-Recruitment\-Controller'. It extends an abstract controller and implements a 'handle' method that retrieves a default path for the recruitment module and redirects to it. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the recruitment plugin, managing module routing.

classes.name: RecruitmentModuleController
classes.description: A controller class handling the recruitment module routing, redirecting to the default recruitment page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by obtaining the default recruitment module path and redirecting the user to it.
